subject: VPC endpoints & IP allowlist \u000B integration next steps
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: VPC endpoints & IP allowlist --- integration next steps

Hi Alex - thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan for the integration: 

Summary from today
- Goal: Private connectivity between FinPay VPC and Redwood Private control plane + inference endpoints for embeddings/reranker and tool-calling.
- Key concerns: IP allowlist, egress/NAT IPs, DNS resolution (egress DNS vs VPC endpoints), mTLS for client auth, and SDK/auth setup for private endpoint.

Action items (owner / ETA)
1) FinPay: share network CIDR(s) and point of contact for firewall config - Alex / this week
2) Redwood: share static egress IP ranges, sample mTLS client config, and SDK quickstart for private deployments - Lauren / by EOD Monday
3) Joint: schedule integration working session to walk network team through diagram and handoffs - propose 30-min working call (Calendly link below)

Notes / technical details
- We recommend using VPC Endpoints (PrivateLink) to avoid public egress when possible. If you need outbound DNS resolution for external artifacts, we'll document options for controlled egress via specific NAT IPs.
- For auth in Private deployments we support mTLS client certs or mutual-auth service accounts with short-lived tokens. We'll surface both options in the SDK guide.
- Embeddings + reranker work over the private endpoint; reranker can be run as a server-side job using your network and the private inference endpoint. Tool-calling (structured outputs) is supported - we can demo structured output + tool calling in the integration call.

Attachments: redwood-vpc-integration-checklist.pdf (integration checklist + sample config)

Available times for the working session: https://calendly.com/lauren-bishop/30min

Thanks - I'll follow up with the network diagram and sample mTLS config.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.ai

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@finpay.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: VPC endpoints & IP allowlist --- integration next steps

Thanks Lauren - great summary. A few clarifying items from our side: 

1) Egress / DNS: are you expecting us to proxy DNS over our NAT or will Redwood provide private DNS resolution over the VPC endpoint? We prefer no public DNS leakage.
2) mTLS rotation: what's the cert rotation cadence you recommend? Do you support automated rotation (ACME) or do we need to manage CSR flows manually?
3) Embeddings / Reranker: can we run the reranker entirely inside our VPC (i.e., call your private endpoints only) so no embeddings leave our network in plaintext before indexing?
4) Tool calling: any additional firewall rules/ports needed beyond HTTPS (443)?

Attaching our current network CIDRs for the team: finpay-network-cidrs.xlsx

We can meet next Tuesday or Wednesday morning PT - I'll pick a slot on the Calendly link.

--Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform, FinPay
alex.j@finpay.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: VPC endpoints & IP allowlist --- integration next steps

Hi Alex - thanks for the questions. Answers below and next steps.

1) DNS / VPC Endpoints:
- Preferred: configure a VPC endpoint (PrivateLink) so DNS resolves the Redwood private endpoint IPs inside your VPC; this avoids public DNS egress.
- Fallback: if you must use NAT egress, we'll provide a minimal set of NAT IPs and recommend forwarding DNS over TLS to your resolver.

2) mTLS rotation:
- We support both managed rotation (Redwood issues short-lived client certs and rotates automatically for Dedicated/Private customers) and CSR-based manual rotation. For initial integration we typically start with CSR + 1-year certs, then move to automated rotation. We'll document the CSR flow in sample-mtls-config.txt.

3) Embeddings & reranker architecture:
- Yes - embeddings can be created inside your VPC against the private inference endpoint. Reranker can be deployed as a job that calls the private endpoint only; model artifacts and tokenized data do not exit your private network unless explicitly configured.

4) Firewall / Ports:
- Required: 443 (HTTPS) outbound to Redwood private endpoint IPs.
- Optional: 53 (DNS) if you need to resolve external domains via NAT; otherwise PrivateLink handles DNS.
- We'll provide exact CIDR blocks and ports for your allowlist.

Next steps: attaching network_diagram.pdf and sample-mtls-config.txt. Marissa will open an internal ticket to provision the IP allowlist and collect the CSR.

Links: Calendly - https://calendly.com/lauren-bishop/30min

Attachments: network_diagram.pdf, sample-mtls-config.txt

Let me know if you'd like us to loop in Solutions Engineering and InfoSec for the working session.

Best,
Lauren
